desc_antes:
Anamon is not just another parasol – it redefines what an outdoor umbrella can be.

The Anamon is a visionary outdoor solution that redefines the concept of shade through "organic engineering." Designed by Kris Van Puyvelde, this parasol mimics the graceful unfurling of a blooming flower, opening from the top down to reveal its canopy without disturbing nearby furniture. When closed, its minimalist vertical column hides all mechanics, doubling as a sleek, sculptural element for any high-end terrace or poolside.

Engineered for both day and night, the Anamon provides cooling shade under the sun and transforms into a sculptural light source after dark. Its integrated warm white LED lighting is battery-powered, ensuring a clean look free of cables. With a focus on longevity, the design includes a protective top cap and a discreet internal drainage system to safeguard the mechanism from the elements.

At the turn of a handle, the parasol seamlessly unfolds with a theatrical reveal, while the inner workings remain discreetly hidden. Call it organic engineering, inspired by the fluid, natural motion of tube-dwelling anemones.

Once the sun sets, Anamon continues to shine. With the canopy tucked away, it transforms into a sculptural light source.

When Anamon is not in use, the top cap clicks effortlessly into place, providing a sleek, polished finish and protecting the mechanism from rain, dust and debris – an especially useful feature in wet climates or during winter. Any water that does find its way inside is directed out through a discreet drainage system at the base – no build-up or mess.

h1_despues: Pebble Sofa by Moroso | Pebble Rubble
desc_antes:
The innovative Pebble Rubble design conveys a message that transcends the functions and qualities of a common seat. The most evident characteristic is the similarity of the upholstered volumes to those massive rocks, polished by the tireless rain and wind and cloaked by an organic or plant layer capable of softening its roughness and making the surfaces comfortable and welcoming. A scenic installation that doesn’t stop at simply simulating, but rests on a lengthy research during which the designers investigated the therapeutic benefits that nature has on people’s physical and mental health, as well as the cultural and psychological significance of natural environments, in particular those found in the designers’ native Sweden.

These exclusive Italian sofas are composed of elements in polyurethane foam with differentiated density, covered with polyester fiber and with internal wooden structure. Backrests made with a lightweight composite structure in polymeric materials and polyurethane foam with a wooden base. Glides in black polypropylene screwed to the structure. The covers of this collection are offered in fabric and are not removable. Also optional ottomans and decorative cushions are offered to complement these versatile lounge chairs. Made in Italy.

desc_antes: Crafted by the masters of high-end Italian glamour at Rugiano, the Floyd Nightstand is an elite bedside masterpiece, perfectly suited for palatial master bedrooms, upscale penthouse suites, and luxury boutique hotel chambers. desc_despues:
Crafted by the masters of high-end Italian glamour at Rugiano, the Floyd Nightstand is an elite bedside masterpiece, perfectly suited for palatial master bedrooms, upscale penthouse suites, and luxury boutique hotel chambers. The piece is defined by a pure, compact cylindrical volume entirely clad in premium leather with fine visible stitching that highlights its round silhouette. It reflects a luxury lifestyle that delights in multi-tier architectural detail; a dramatic upper marble top acts as a canvas for striking organic veining, while the open understructure reveals a calibrated interplay of solids and voids featuring a matching second marble shelf—all bound together by a precision bronzed metal framework that integrates a handle-free, seamless storage drawer. Made in Italy.

A Cylindrical Nightstand in Leather and Stone

The composition is deliberately quiet: the round volume reads as a sculptural presence, a softer counterpoint to the linear geometries that surround it. What distinguishes the piece is the dialogue of materials — the warmth of the hide against the cool veining of the stone, mediated by the dry lustre of the bronzed metal, with every transition resolved through the quiet precision of Italian craftsmanship. The curve invites the hand as much as the eye, and glamour is entrusted to proportion and finish rather than applied ornament. Within the New RUGIANO Collection, this leather bedside table stands as a study in restraint.
